messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD12345 - SEV2: Latency SLO burn (p99) in eu-west dedicated pool for >5m. Auto-page sent to oncall.
alice: Ack. Oncall here, looking into p99 spike.
alice: Quick skim of traces -> p95 ok, p99 spiking to ~5s for generation endpoints. High tail around KV lookup + tokenizer step.
priya: Logs show tokenizer GC pauses and some sidecar CPU saturation on a subset of nodes. Dashboard: https://redwood/dash/PD12345
dan: Any errors or customer 5xxs?
alece (typo)
lee: Customers seeing slow responses but no increased 5xxs reported from CS so far.
alice: Noted. Risk to SLA but functional. Marking customer-impact: potential degradation for long responses.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: next escalation in 7m if not resolved.
alice: Mitigation plan: 1) route a portion of EU traffic to fallback model variant with smaller context (lower latency) 2) trigger +2 capacity on eu-west dedicated pool 3) run KV cache warmup for hot prefixes. I'll coordinate routing change.
priya: Will start the scale-up and run warmup script. Pushing routing patch now.
priya: ```
# patch routing policy to prefer-fallback for eu-west
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/configs/routing -d '{"region":"eu-west","policy":"prefer-fallback"}'
```
dan: Kicking autoscaler: aws-autoscaler group eu-west-dedicated +2 instances.
incident-bot: Config change detected: routing policy update by priya.
priya: Warmup script started: ```
python tools/warm_kv.py --region eu-west --prefixes recent_hotkeys --concurrency 8
```
lee: Running quick smoke: tail logs for tokenization latencies.
alice: p99 trending down from 5.0s -> 1.2s within 3m of change. Monitoring graphs.
dan: New instances are healthy and joined pool.
priya: p99 now ~620ms, p95 steady at ~120ms. No errors. CS informed (cs-ops).
lee: Leaving a sticky note for night oncall: keep fallback routing until p99 < 500ms for 30m, otherwise escalate to infra.
alice: Agreed. Drafted customer bulletin that we saw elevated latencies and mitigated by routing and scaling.
priya: Adding follow-up task: investigate tokenizer GC and sidecar CPU hotspots, add hotkey throttling experiment.
alice: Handing off to lee for watch until stable. Handoff at 18:00 UTC. Flags: PD12345 remains open but no active page.
lee: Ack takeover. I'll monitor for 2h and will notify if p99 crosses 700ms.
alice: Thanks all :thumbsup: — marking incident as mitigated for now, will file post-incident runbook item.
priya: Closing local mitigation loop. Follow-up ticket: INF-4123 (tokenizer GC tuning + hotkey defense).
cs-ops: Noted customer-facing note, will update support threads if anything changes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 status -> acknowledged by alice. Auto-escalation snoozed.
lee: Keeping watch.
